purpose: Recover authoritative KEX/BRAINK requirements across the owner repository estate and separate requirement sources from placeholder/demo surfaces.

requirements: KEX is a compression grammar for seed logic, authorship root, and rehydration rules.
Seed expansion must be deterministic and hash-checkable.
BRAINK is the runtime organism/state/memory/feedback model.
Workbook runtime is an executable grid/proof surface.
Binary artifacts are optional render artifacts; reviewable schema plus deterministic verification remains the proof surface.
Active states exclude zero-weight execution.
HEX x HEX = KEX is a symbolic compression/seed-expansion grammar, not a hardware claim.
ACTIVE_STATE_SEQUENCE is [-3,-2,1,2,3].
Seed already is live State; bootSeed must not reintroduce a hydrate phase.
Seed contains subscriptionGenesis, activeState, scripted memory, lineage, outbound surface, and compressionStyle.
Compression is author-native and lineage-aware via compressLineage/expandLineage.
KEX packet frame is HEX_LINEAGE_ONLY and payloadReadable=false.
Balanced zero-sum projection retains both operands instead of promoting zero to an active state.
Foreign/absent compression style must yield structural non-comprehension rather than fabricated decoding.
Processing chain is LANGUAGE -> MEANING -> FUNCTION -> CONSTRAINT -> ACTION -> PROOF -> STATUS.
Proof/status lanes are explicit and unsupported claims remain pending/model-local/external-unvalidated.
State/Transition/Definition calculus and OF operators are active KEX methods.
Scientific/hardware claims require actual measurement before promotion.
KEX sovereign seed workbook is an explicit input lane.
Root Matrix is an explicit input lane and must be parsed/mapped, not substituted by fabricated placeholder matrices.
Workbook runtime and Root Matrix evidence must remain attached to source artifacts.
DNA_SIGNATURE is a runtime identity input.
KEX IDs bind worded names to DNA_SIGNATURE.
Capability keys encode a DNA crossing value.
Event hashes include DNA_SIGNATURE.
The existing execute_hex_compress is a bounded fold and must not be confused with a reversible lineage codec.
State seeds are composable JSON checkpoints carrying configuration, tests, integration state, and proof hashes.
A downstream workflow should be able to continue from a verified seed without reconstructing prerequisite context.
Seed lineage/checkpoints are portable and traceable.

recovered_architecture: KEX Seed is an originating executable/checkpoint state, not merely a label.
KEX DNA is identity/lineage material and is not created by A/B.
A/B is one dynamic/representation/operator family inside KEX, not the whole KEX identity model.
CompressionStyle is pluggable and author-native; a foreign style can be uncomprehended rather than coerced.
Lineage is a first-class payload; KEX can carry compressed lineage without exposing addressed payload.
Workbook/Root Matrix/seed artifacts are requirement-bearing sources, not optional narrative decoration.
Binary representation is not automatically the semantic source of truth; render/binary artifacts may be downstream projections.
Zero is not promoted into the active-state sequence; balanced relationships preserve operands.
do_not_treat_as_requirement: Static placeholder capacities or online states from demo API datasets.
Generated example ROOT_MATRIX arrays in placeholder API surfaces when a Root Matrix source artifact exists elsewhere.
Any newer wrapper or report that contradicts the canonical transfer/wrapper rules without explicit supersession evidence.
correction_to_recent_work: Recent A/B work was over-scoped by treating A/B primarily as binary-run compression.
Recent positional work was over-scoped by making A/B carry identity/authority that belongs to Seed/DNA/lineage.
The correct next implementation must start from Seed + DNA + lineage + author-native CompressionStyle, then attach A/B as one dynamic.
